nl_query: List all active accounts with their account type
gold_sql: SELECT account_number, account_type FROM brokerage.accounts WHERE status = 'ACTIVE';

nl_query: Show the email and phone number for customer PAN ABCDE1234F
gold_sql: SELECT email, phone FROM brokerage.customers WHERE pan_number = 'ABCDE1234F';

nl_query: Which customers hold the account with number ACC10023?
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, c.customer_code FROM brokerage.customers c JOIN brokerage.account_holders ah ON ah.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN brokerage.accounts a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id WHERE a.account_number = 'ACC10023';

nl_query: Show all open orders with the instrument symbol they were placed for
gold_sql: SELECT o.order_ref, i.symbol, o.side, o.quantity, o.status FROM brokerage.orders o JOIN brokerage.instruments i ON i.instrument_id = o.instrument_id WHERE o.status = 'OPEN';

nl_query: What is the total traded value per instrument for trades executed today?
gold_sql: SELECT i.symbol, SUM(t.trade_value) AS total_value FROM brokerage.trades t JOIN brokerage.instruments i ON i.instrument_id = t.instrument_id WHERE t.executed_at::date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY i.symbol ORDER BY total_value DESC;

nl_query: How many customers do not yet have a verified KYC status?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM brokerage.customers c LEFT JOIN brokerage.customer_kyc k ON k.customer_id = c.customer_id AND k.status = 'VERIFIED' WHERE k.kyc_id IS NULL;

nl_query: Show all accounts whose margin utilization risk limit is currently breached
gold_sql: SELECT a.account_number, rl.limit_value, rl.current_value FROM brokerage.accounts a JOIN brokerage.risk_limits rl ON rl.account_id = a.account_id WHERE rl.limit_type = 'MARGIN_UTILIZATION' AND rl.is_breached = TRUE;

nl_query: Find accounts whose cash balance is below the average cash balance across all active accounts
gold_sql: SELECT account_number, cash_balance FROM brokerage.accounts WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND cash_balance < (SELECT AVG(cash_balance) FROM brokerage.accounts WHERE status = 'ACTIVE');

nl_query: List the top 5 customers by total trade value in the last 30 days
gold_sql: SELECT c.full_name, SUM(t.trade_value) AS total_value FROM brokerage.trades t JOIN brokerage.account_holders ah ON ah.account_id = t.account_id JOIN brokerage.customers c ON c.customer_id = ah.customer_id WHERE t.executed_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY c.full_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 5;

nl_query: For each account, show the running total of cash ledger entries ordered by transaction date
gold_sql: SELECT account_id, txn_date, amount, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_date) AS running_total FROM brokerage.ledger_transactions ORDER BY account_id, txn_date;

nl_query: Which accounts have unprocessed dividend entitlements?
gold_sql: SELECT a.account_number, cae.entitled_amount FROM brokerage.corporate_action_entitlements cae JOIN brokerage.corporate_actions ca ON ca.corp_action_id = cae.corp_action_id JOIN brokerage.accounts a ON a.account_id = cae.account_id WHERE ca.action_type = 'DIVIDEND' AND cae.processed = FALSE;

nl_query: Show current open positions with unrealized quantity greater than zero, sorted by instrument
gold_sql: SELECT i.symbol, p.net_quantity, p.average_price FROM brokerage.positions p JOIN brokerage.instruments i ON i.instrument_id = p.instrument_id WHERE p.net_quantity > 0 ORDER BY i.symbol;

nl_query: List all call options expiring this month with their strike price
gold_sql: SELECT symbol, strike_price, expiry_date FROM brokerage.instruments WHERE instrument_type = 'OPTION' AND option_type = 'CALL' AND date_trunc('month', expiry_date) = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);
